perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Lead from Gold
enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Closing Time
enhanced.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Controlled Burst
enhanced.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Kickstart

enhanced.name: Kickstart
enhanced.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for an improved duration.

perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst

enhanced.name: Reservoir Burst
enhanced.description: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Withering Gaze
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a shorter period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Dimensional Shift
enhanced.description: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a higher value Void Overshield.

flavor: "Why not use these gifts we've been given?" —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
